blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.20
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.20

blocks.text: त्रिषु चतुर्थं तैलवदासेच्यम्
blocks.directed: [slowly] त्रिषु चतुर्थं तैलवदासेच्यम्

blocks.text: Triṣu caturthaṃ tailavad āsecyam.
blocks.directed: Triṣu caturthaṃ tailavad āsecyam.

blocks.text: The fourth should be poured into the three like oil.
blocks.directed: The fourth should be poured into the three like oil.

blocks.text: Pour Turya Over Your Entire Life Like Divine Olive Oil.
blocks.directed: Pour Turya Over Your Entire Life Like Divine Olive Oil.

blocks.text: Ladies and gentlemen.
blocks.directed: Ladies and gentlemen.

blocks.text: This might be one of the most beautiful instructions in the entire Śiva Sūtras.
blocks.directed: This might be one of the most beautiful instructions in the entire Śiva Sūtras.

blocks.text: And also one of the funniest when translated literally.
blocks.directed: And also one of the funniest when translated literally.

blocks.text: Because Vasugupta has apparently decided that supreme consciousness is a substance with which the other states should be thoroughly basted.
blocks.directed: Because Vasugupta has apparently decided that supreme consciousness is a substance with which the other states should be thoroughly basted.

blocks.text: Tailavat.
blocks.directed: Tailavat.

blocks.text: Like oil.
blocks.directed: Like oil.

blocks.text: Wonderful.
blocks.directed: Wonderful.

blocks.text: Let’s unpack it.
blocks.directed: Let’s unpack it.

blocks.text: Triṣu — into the three.
blocks.directed: Triṣu — into the three.

blocks.text: Caturtham — the fourth.
blocks.directed: Caturtham — the fourth.

blocks.text: Tailavat — like oil.
blocks.directed: Tailavat — like oil.

blocks.text: Āsecyam — should be poured, sprinkled, infused.
blocks.directed: Āsecyam — should be poured, sprinkled, infused.

blocks.text: Now, what are the three?
blocks.directed: Now, what are the three?

blocks.text: Waking.
blocks.directed: Waking.

blocks.text: Dreaming.
blocks.directed: Dreaming.

blocks.text: Deep sleep.
blocks.directed: Deep sleep.

blocks.text: Jāgrat. Svapna. Suṣupti.
blocks.directed: Jāgrat. Svapna. Suṣupti.

blocks.text: And what’s the fourth?
blocks.directed: And what’s the fourth?

blocks.text: Turya.
blocks.directed: Turya.

blocks.text: The underlying nondual consciousness.
blocks.directed: The underlying nondual consciousness.

blocks.text: We’ve encountered this several times.
blocks.directed: We’ve encountered this several times.

blocks.text: But now the instruction becomes exceptionally concrete.
blocks.directed: But now the instruction becomes exceptionally concrete.

blocks.text: The fourth is to permeate the other three.
blocks.directed: The fourth is to permeate the other three.

blocks.text: Not merely appear during meditation.
blocks.directed: Not merely appear during meditation.

blocks.text: Not merely be recognised at the beginning of a dream.
blocks.directed: Not merely be recognised at the beginning of a dream.

blocks.text: Not merely become momentarily apparent when the mind falls silent.
blocks.directed: Not merely become momentarily apparent when the mind falls silent.

blocks.text: It must become established throughout the changing conditions of experience.
blocks.directed: It must become established throughout the changing conditions of experience.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja explains this with extraordinary precision.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja explains this with extraordinary precision.

blocks.text: He says that oil gradually spreads through and permeates what receives it.
blocks.directed: He says that oil gradually spreads through and permeates what receives it.

blocks.text: In the same way, the bliss of turya is to become increasingly pervasive throughout the three states.
blocks.directed: In the same way, the bliss of turya is to become increasingly pervasive throughout the three states.

blocks.text: Now imagine pouring oil onto cloth.
blocks.directed: Now imagine pouring oil onto cloth.

blocks.text: At first, it touches one small region.
blocks.directed: At first, it touches one small region.

blocks.text: Then it spreads.
blocks.directed: Then it spreads.

blocks.text: It penetrates the fibres.
blocks.directed: It penetrates the fibres.

blocks.text: Gradually, a larger portion becomes saturated.
blocks.directed: Gradually, a larger portion becomes saturated.

blocks.text: The oil doesn’t have to destroy the cloth to permeate it.
blocks.directed: The oil doesn’t have to destroy the cloth to permeate it.

blocks.text: The cloth remains.
blocks.directed: The cloth remains.

blocks.text: But its condition changes.
blocks.directed: But its condition changes.

blocks.text: And that’s the analogy.
blocks.directed: And that’s the analogy.

blocks.text: The waking state doesn’t necessarily disappear.
blocks.directed: The waking state doesn’t necessarily disappear.

blocks.text: Dreaming doesn’t have to be abolished.
blocks.directed: Dreaming doesn’t have to be abolished.

blocks.text: Deep sleep doesn’t have to be replaced by some permanently excited mental condition.
blocks.directed: Deep sleep doesn’t have to be replaced by some permanently excited mental condition.

blocks.text: Instead, the underlying conscious reality is recognised throughout their changing forms.
blocks.directed: Instead, the underlying conscious reality is recognised throughout their changing forms.

blocks.text: And now comes a particularly subtle distinction.
blocks.directed: And now comes a particularly subtle distinction.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explicitly contrasts this with the teaching of Book I.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explicitly contrasts this with the teaching of Book I.

blocks.text: Remember:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Remember:

blocks.text: जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तभेदे तुर्याभोगसम्भवः।
blocks.directed: [slowly] जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तभेदे तुर्याभोगसम्भवः।

blocks.text: Jāgratsvapnasuṣuptabhede turyābhogasambhavaḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Jāgratsvapnasuṣuptabhede turyābhogasambhavaḥ.

blocks.text: The enjoyment of turya is possible through the distinctions of waking, dreaming and deep sleep.
blocks.directed: The enjoyment of turya is possible through the distinctions of waking, dreaming and deep sleep.

blocks.text: That was 1.7.
blocks.directed: That was 1.7.

blocks.text: And then:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And then:

blocks.text: त्रितयभोक्ता वीरेशः।
blocks.directed: [slowly] त्रितयभोक्ता वीरेशः।

blocks.text: Tritayabhoktā vīreśaḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Tritayabhoktā vīreśaḥ.

blocks.text: The experiencer of the three is the lord of the heroes.
blocks.directed: The experiencer of the three is the lord of the heroes.

blocks.text: That was 1.11.
blocks.directed: That was 1.11.

blocks.text: But the method described in Śāmbhavopāya concerns a more immediate, powerful recognition.
blocks.directed: But the method described in Śāmbhavopāya concerns a more immediate, powerful recognition.

blocks.text: Here in Āṇavopāya, Kṣemarāja describes a gradual process.
blocks.directed: Here in Āṇavopāya, Kṣemarāja describes a gradual process.

blocks.text: The practitioner begins with moments of recognition.
blocks.directed: The practitioner begins with moments of recognition.

blocks.text: Perhaps at the transition between mental states.
blocks.directed: Perhaps at the transition between mental states.

blocks.text: Perhaps when thought subsides.
blocks.directed: Perhaps when thought subsides.

blocks.text: Perhaps during deep absorption.
blocks.directed: Perhaps during deep absorption.

blocks.text: But those moments are not yet sufficient.
blocks.directed: But those moments are not yet sufficient.

blocks.text: The recognition must extend into the intervening experience.
blocks.directed: The recognition must extend into the intervening experience.

blocks.text: The ordinary movement of awareness.
blocks.directed: The ordinary movement of awareness.

blocks.text: The countless activities of waking life.
blocks.directed: The countless activities of waking life.

blocks.text: And this is where the metaphor of oil becomes magnificent.
blocks.directed: And this is where the metaphor of oil becomes magnificent.

blocks.text: You’re not trying to isolate one sacred moment from all the other moments.
blocks.directed: You’re not trying to isolate one sacred moment from all the other moments.

blocks.text: You’re allowing recognition to pervade the entire structure of experience.
blocks.directed: You’re allowing recognition to pervade the entire structure of experience.

blocks.text: Now think about what that means in practice.
blocks.directed: Now think about what that means in practice.

blocks.text: You sit in meditation.
blocks.directed: You sit in meditation.

blocks.text: There’s a moment of extraordinary clarity.
blocks.directed: There’s a moment of extraordinary clarity.

blocks.text: The usual sense of separate selfhood relaxes.
blocks.directed: The usual sense of separate selfhood relaxes.

blocks.text: You recognise awareness as the ground of experience.
blocks.directed: You recognise awareness as the ground of experience.

blocks.text: Beautiful.
blocks.directed: Beautiful.

blocks.text: Then you get up.
blocks.directed: Then you get up.

blocks.text: You walk outside.
blocks.directed: You walk outside.

blocks.text: Somebody drops a plate.
blocks.directed: Somebody drops a plate.

blocks.text: A dog starts barking.
blocks.directed: A dog starts barking.

blocks.text: A motorbike drives past.
blocks.directed: A motorbike drives past.

blocks.text: And suddenly:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And suddenly:

blocks.text: “FOR FUCK’S SAKE, CAN EVERYONE PLEASE BE QUIET, I’M TRYING TO BE ŚIVA.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “FOR FUCK’S SAKE, CAN EVERYONE PLEASE BE QUIET, I’M TRYING TO BE ŚIVA.”

blocks.text: Well.
blocks.directed: Well.

blocks.text: The oil hasn’t spread very far, has it?
blocks.directed: The oil hasn’t spread very far, has it?

blocks.text: The recognition has remained confined to one particular circumstance.
blocks.directed: The recognition has remained confined to one particular circumstance.

blocks.text: The task is to discover the same fundamental reality amidst the changing contents of experience.
blocks.directed: The task is to discover the same fundamental reality amidst the changing contents of experience.

blocks.text: And here’s an important correction.
blocks.directed: And here’s an important correction.

blocks.text: The sūtra isn’t instructing the practitioner to remain physically awake throughout deep sleep.
blocks.directed: The sūtra isn’t instructing the practitioner to remain physically awake throughout deep sleep.

blocks.text: It’s describing the pervasion of the three states by the recognition of turya within the tradition’s contemplative framework.
blocks.directed: It’s describing the pervasion of the three states by the recognition of turya within the tradition’s contemplative framework.

blocks.text: It is not a recommendation to deprive yourself of sleep or strain to maintain ordinary alertness while unconscious.
blocks.directed: It is not a recommendation to deprive yourself of sleep or strain to maintain ordinary alertness while unconscious.

blocks.text: The metaphysical issue is the continuity of consciousness, not the elimination of physiological sleep.
blocks.directed: The metaphysical issue is the continuity of consciousness, not the elimination of physiological sleep.

blocks.text: And now Kṣemarāja introduces a crucial detail.
blocks.directed: And now Kṣemarāja introduces a crucial detail.

blocks.text: He refers to the initial and final boundaries of the three states.
blocks.directed: He refers to the initial and final boundaries of the three states.

blocks.text: The moments of emergence.
blocks.directed: The moments of emergence.

blocks.text: The moments of subsidence.
blocks.directed: The moments of subsidence.

blocks.text: But says the practitioner should also permeate their middle.
blocks.directed: But says the practitioner should also permeate their middle.

blocks.text: The intervening condition.
blocks.directed: The intervening condition.

blocks.text: Why?
blocks.directed: Why?

blocks.text: Because it’s relatively easy, within this contemplative framework, to value the special transition.
blocks.directed: Because it’s relatively easy, within this contemplative framework, to value the special transition.

blocks.text: The moment of silence.
blocks.directed: The moment of silence.

blocks.text: The moment before a thought.
blocks.directed: The moment before a thought.

blocks.text: The moment of waking.
blocks.directed: The moment of waking.

blocks.text: The extraordinary gap.
blocks.directed: The extraordinary gap.

blocks.text: But what about the rest of experience?
blocks.directed: But what about the rest of experience?

blocks.text: What about the ongoing activity?
blocks.directed: What about the ongoing activity?

blocks.text: What about the entire middle of your life?
blocks.directed: What about the entire middle of your life?

blocks.text: That’s where the recognition must become established.
blocks.directed: That’s where the recognition must become established.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explains this as an Āṇavopāya-specific form of sustained attentiveness, distinguishing it from the more immediate attainment discussed in the first section. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explains this as an Āṇavopāya-specific form of sustained attentiveness, distinguishing it from the more immediate attainment discussed in the first section. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: And this is why the metaphor is so extraordinary.
blocks.directed: And this is why the metaphor is so extraordinary.

blocks.text: The point isn’t to acquire a fourth experience and then abandon the other three.
blocks.directed: The point isn’t to acquire a fourth experience and then abandon the other three.

blocks.text: It’s to recognise the fourth as fundamental throughout them.
blocks.directed: It’s to recognise the fourth as fundamental throughout them.

blocks.text: The cloth remains.
blocks.directed: The cloth remains.

blocks.text: The oil permeates it.
blocks.directed: The oil permeates it.

blocks.text: And gradually the whole thing becomes saturated.
blocks.directed: And gradually the whole thing becomes saturated.

blocks.text: Which, if you think about it, is an absolutely beautiful image for spiritual integration.
blocks.directed: Which, if you think about it, is an absolutely beautiful image for spiritual integration.

blocks.text: Not escaping the world.
blocks.directed: Not escaping the world.

blocks.text: Not rejecting experience.
blocks.directed: Not rejecting experience.

blocks.text: Not constructing a separate sacred compartment.
blocks.directed: Not constructing a separate sacred compartment.

blocks.text: But recognising the conscious reality through every condition of life.
blocks.directed: But recognising the conscious reality through every condition of life.

blocks.text: And now Vasugupta gives the method.
blocks.directed: And now Vasugupta gives the method.

blocks.text: How do you actually enter this fourth condition?
blocks.directed: How do you actually enter this fourth condition?

blocks.text: Well, apparently you have to plunge into it with your mind.
blocks.directed: Well, apparently you have to plunge into it with your mind.

blocks.text: Then relinquish the very mental operations you used to approach it.
blocks.directed: Then relinquish the very mental operations you used to approach it.

blocks.text: Which is a perfectly normal sort of paradox for Kashmir.
blocks.directed: Which is a perfectly normal sort of paradox for Kashmir.
